Auto-reassigned review from Gemini to Codex after repeated Gemini terminal: Unexpected critical provider failure
Changes requested: root OPERATOR_ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX.md regresses CLI/internal fallback truth and misroutes pause/rollback to S-EMRG. See docs/reviews/BG-006-review-codex.md.

All three blocking findings addressed in root OPERATOR_ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX.md: (1) S-CLI rows corrected from 'not implemented' to 'spec defined' for deployment, runtime pause, and kill-switch. (2) BFF-unavailable degraded behavior for pause and rollback now routes to S-IAPI/S-CLI, not S-EMRG. S-CLI pause row description updated to clarify it is the admin CLI direct path, not the kill-switch fast path. (3) runtime-manager outage row now lists RT-01–RT-04 as degraded/unavailable, removing the overstated 'BFF read unaffected' claim. (4) Routing rule 2 updated to separate general fallback (S-IAPI/S-CLI) from kill-switch emergency path (S-EMRG). (5) Section 9 open item updated from 'S-CLI spec future work' to 'S-CLI production hardening'. Evidence table entry for CLI fallback drill updated to remove stale '(CLI not implemented)' qualifier. Ready for re-review.

Re-review requested: previous CLI/routing/runtime-manager fixes are in place, but Section 5 role matrix still contradicts the per-surface authorization rows. See docs/reviews/BG-006-review-codex.md and align fallback surface access with the operation tables before resubmitting.

Section 5 role matrix repaired: (1) governance.approver: S-IAPI removed — direct S-IAPI write requires governance.admin + mTLS (§4.4). (2) deployment.operator: S-CLI fallback removed — CLI deployment requires deployment.admin (§4.1). (3) runtime.operator: S-EMRG fallback removed — S-EMRG requires emergency.operator (§4.2/§4.3). (4) runtime.admin: S-EMRG removed — S-EMRG requires emergency.operator; retains S-IAPI and S-CLI per §4.2. All four rows now match the per-surface authorization tables. Ready for re-review.

Review approved: OPERATOR_ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX.md now aligns Section 5 role access with the per-surface authorization rows, keeps the prior CLI/internal fallback and BFF-outage routing fixes intact, and leaves no blocking GAP-06 acceptance issues. Return to Claude for finalization.
